desc:
Welcome to TR Legacy, an open-world motorcycle experience built around riding, racing, collecting, customizing and progressing with friends.

Explore a large open world, collect and customize motorcycles, compete in races, take on delivery jobs, build your bike collection, and earn your way to the top. Race at hand made circuits, cruise the streets, chase leaderboard times, or just ride with friends. 

🏁Race across multiple tracks and modes
🏍️Collect and customize motorcycles
🌎Explore a detailed open world
📦Complete delivery jobs for cash
🏆Earn badges & climb leaderboards
💰Build your collection and progress
👥Ride and race with friends
🌧️Dynamic weather, night riding & more

Join the group to get 30% extra cash!

Current code : INSANE105K
🎁 Next code at 110,000 Likes!

Controls:
• V — Toggle Camera
• Shift — Handbrake
• Q / E — Shift Down / Up
• M — Toggle Transmission
• Shift + P — Custom Freecam
• T — Wheelie

Released : July 11th, 2026
